content: Information Technology Centre (IT Centre) established in 2011 under Registrar Office to manage and support university IT infrastructure including computer networks, systems, UPS and power equipment, wireless hotspots, online databases, IP phones, video conferencing, university web portal, digital library, multimedia operations, CCTV surveillance, attendance & payroll system, campus wireless connectivity, HEC IT projects, IT procurement liaison, network maintenance, IT policy management, and IT skills development for staff and faculty.
